findings.reason: the node whose premise is "a module this size cannot be handed whole to a local-lane worker" is asked to hold that module plus three more source files plus 151,384 tokens of gate tests, so the plan should name how the gate is staged or scoped rather than assert it fits one window.
findings.text: §2 grants its write paths "all inside one local-lane window" and its gate runs 16 test files at base and head, but measured at `f5e88d284` the four source files in scope are 226,914 tokens and the 16 gate test files are a further 151,384, totalling 378,298 against the 230,144-token window §1 itself states
